_about: The ONE legacy exception to the v3 release binding (build production-boundary-v1). Single by construction: tools/binding.py refuses a file that names more than one piece, or any id its code does not also name (LEGACY_ALLOWED_IDS). It covers this exact id and nothing else, and pins the approved bytes by digest.
